PtrsLong05895E.name: Layer 2 update table and stripe builders
summary: Pointer table of 3-byte long pointers (CODE_058955 dispatches through it with ExecutePtrLong), indexed by level mode [$1925] (0-$1F).
Followed by the routines it points to. Each builds one stripe of 8x8 tile words in the layer 2 VRAM update buffers at $1CE6-$1D6B:
VRAM address in $1CE6/$1CE7, then two tile words per 16x16 Map16 block, for the layer 2 block position [$49+[$56]].
CODE_058B8D (modes 1-4, horizontal levels): one column of 27 blocks into $1CE8/$1CEA/$1D68/$1D6A.
CODE_058C71 (modes 5-8, vertical levels): one row of 32 blocks into $1CE8 (top) and $1D68 (bottom).
CODE_058D7A (mode 0 and others, prebuilt background): column read from the Map16 copy at $7E:B900/$7E:BD00, using $1928.
Both level-mode routines OR [$03] = $1000 into every tile word when tileset [$1931] = 3 (palette bit 2).
Layer 1 uses near-identical routines at CODE_0589CE (column) and CODE_058A9B (row) with buffers at $1BE4-$1D65.
Note: LEVEL_PIPELINE_NOTES.md labels the 0588EC/058955 pair layer 2/layer 3; the RAM use ($45 vs $49, $1BE4 vs $1CE6) points to layer 1/layer 2.
